prompts.boy: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game sprite sheet on genuinely transparent background. Original charming but cool BOY adventurer for a Korean grade-four fantasy action game, age-appropriate young male hero with short tousled dark teal hair, confident eyebrows, navy adventurer jacket, teal scarf, practical trousers, leather boots, small gold star clasp. Clearly boyish silhouette, no skirt, no bunny ears, no weapon (weapon rendered separately). Polished hand-painted chibi JRPG art, 3 heads tall, readable at small size, not babyish. Four equal cells in exactly ONE horizontal row, same character same scale and aligned feet: idle front three-quarter, walking front three-quarter, attacking empty hand extended right, dashing right. Full figure with generous transparent padding at every cell edge, no neighboring cell overlap, each figure entirely within central 70% of cell. Canvas wide 4:1. No lettering, no border, no ground or shadows, no brand references.
prompts.monsters: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production 2D monster sprite atlas, transparent background, exactly FIVE columns by TWO rows, 10 equally sized square cells. Friendly bright fantasy game monsters for 9-10 year olds, glossy rounded jelly and soft plush-like shapes, small simple smiling faces, no teeth, claws, horns, exposed organs, insects or frightening eyes. Not a copy of an existing game mascot. Cute yet distinct silhouettes, polished hand-painted JRPG sprites, front three-quarter view, whole body centered within central 65% of each cell, consistent feet baseline, generous transparent gutters. ROW 1 left to right: mint leaf jelly that hops, orange round dumpling with little stone helmet that charges, blue water jelly with a bubble wand that shoots, purple grape jelly twins joined together that split, yellow fluffy cloud with little orbiting stars. ROW 2 left to right: pink flower jelly healer, BIG forest guardian moss jelly with a wooden crown, BIG sand guardian amber jelly with floating hourglass charm, BIG ember guardian round red panda-like plush spirit in rounded armor, BIG cosmic guardian dark-blue smiling star jelly with gold crown and small galaxy halo. Bosses occupy 75% cell, normal monsters 65%. Same style across all 10. No text, no labels, no cell dividers, no scenery, truly alpha transparent. Wide canvas 5:2, each cell square.
prompts.nova: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite sheet of a magical star-wave skill effect for a polished fantasy action game for grade-four students. Exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, six evenly spaced equal square cells, each frame same centered origin. Original luminous aqua and gold star magic, elegant curved comet ribbons, five-point stars, layered translucent glow, no blunt plain circle outlines. Top row: small gathering starlight, bright starburst starting with crescent arcs, expanding spiral crescent wave. Bottom row: wide beautiful five-star ring with translucent luminous ribbons, wide fading glittering crescent wave, last sparse sparkling star dust. Six stages of ONE outward burst animation. Each frame contained in central 85% with transparent edge gutters, no overlap into adjacent cells, transparent background not a black rectangle, no text, no labels, no borders. Clean readable action-game VFX, not overwhelming white flash, keep central character visible.
